title: Strange Geometries
author: Phillip Chambers
description:
Selling all of your worldly goods you bought a small printing press and traveled to Malnoxet, the city at the end of the world and the beginning of new lives. Right on the northern edge of habitable land Malnoxet attracted anyone who no longer wanted to be part of the world.

It was the perfect place to start a newspaper as new stories happened every day, but after a while they started to feel the same. Criminal fleeing justice killed in robbery. Minor public official caught doing something slightly embarrassing. Farmer grows largest vegetable.

Then nearly two weeks ago Anton Penn vanished.
